findings.title: Permissionless migration redeem is a replayable, redirectable accounting-write entry point
findings.impact: Potential attacker entry point — requires specialist confirmation
findings.recommendation: Specialist review required. See ITE decomposition in attack_surface.json (function redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances).

ite.intent: Mint unbacked stalk/roots and redirect silo-deposit credit to an attacker-chosen reciever
ite.technique: Replay public proof+signature (no spent-marker, setStalk uses +=) and exploit that the merkle leaf omits reciever
ite.evasion: MerkleProof.verify + ECDSA.recover pass identically each replay; reciever bound by signature only

findings.title: Oracle TWAP/spot path feeds sunrise mint and convert economics
findings.impact: Potential attacker entry point — requires specialist confirmation
findings.recommendation: Specialist review required. See ITE decomposition in attack_surface.json. Trace whether sunrise/convert mint path requests lookback>0 and consumes the (spot) return.

ite.intent: Force a manipulation-resistant consumer to use a flash-loan-manipulable spot price
ite.technique: Inverted ternary returns spot when TWAP requested; skew spot in one tx to misprice Bean mint/convert
ite.evasion: The only manipulation guard (TWAP) is bypassed by the branch inversion

findings.title: pipelineConvert executes arbitrary external calls before BDV/stalk recompute
findings.impact: Potential attacker entry point — requires specialist confirmation
findings.recommendation: Specialist review required. See ITE decomposition in attack_surface.json. Confirm whether nonReentrant is cross-facet and whether well reserves are re-read post-manipulation.

ite.intent: Mint unbacked BDV/stalk by skewing well reserves mid-convert or reentering while invariants are false
ite.technique: Pipeline arbitrary calls manipulate reserves between cache and recompute, or cross-facet reentry
ite.evasion: Per-facet nonReentrant scope and BDV-preservation check are the only guards

findings.title: Reseed init functions are external with no access modifier
findings.impact: Potential attacker entry point — requires specialist confirmation
findings.recommendation: Specialist review required. Confirm diamondCut wiring: if Reseed*.init selectors are registered as callable facets rather than one-shot delegatecalls, anyone could re-run them and overwrite global accounting (ACCESS-001).

ite.intent: Re-run reseed to overwrite global silo/field/stalk accounting after migration
ite.technique: Call an externally-exposed init() selector that has no owner/role guard
ite.evasion: Relies entirely on diamondCut not exposing init as a selector — no in-function guard exists

findings.title: Tractor executes blueprint calls as the publisher under nonce/publisher-reset guards
findings.impact: Potential attacker entry point — requires specialist confirmation
findings.recommendation: Specialist review required. Trace LibTractor nonce/maxNonce check (STATE-002) and whether activePublisher reset is on the revert path (STATE-004).

ite.intent: Replay a signed blueprint beyond maxNonce or leak a stuck activePublisher to a later caller
ite.technique: Off-by-one/missing nonce check enables replay; non-finally reset leaves publisher context set
ite.evasion: verifyRequisition + runBlueprint set/reset publisher — the question is completeness of those guards
